notes.title: Dominant Mind is Now Available!
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone! 

We've just released a new game, Dominant Mind, and we're excited to read about your experience. It's one of those brainy games and our developers had lots of fun creating it. 

If you've ever played Mastermind, then you know what this is all about. If not, it's a game where you have to guess the code by placing pins of different colors in the right spots on the board. You get to do the same in Dominant Mind, just on your screen. :)

This game is for everyone who wants to give their brain a bit of a power training, but it can also be a fun way to just pass your time. Here's what it looks like:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40343467/49e910917997f97f2ca3a668da0449e1b95f4ce8.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40343467/dc32e90a3578e185b529670c3d5aca3ee5df5b62.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40343467/cd7ff6123a2c456994e516415e47cd08099c4838.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40343467/a19941436578d7abcabc6dd21bef2e5e166af55e.gif[/img]

We hope you'll give our Dominant Mind a try and tell us what you think about it! We'd like to hear your thoughts. 

Good luck on your code-breaking missions! :)
